svg.title: How HyprAesthetic works
svg.desc: Step 1: a theme is a small folder with theme.toml, a wallpaper and a preview. Step 2: you run hat switch. Step 3: Hyprland, Waybar, eww, Hyprwave, Rofi, Kitty, GTK, Dunst and Neovim all get repainted.
svg.text: shows up in the control center
only if you want a different layout
